text: Toland, the Shattered was a Warlock Voidwalker who studied the Darkness and Hive lore, which led to him being deemed mad and exiled from Last City together with his Ghost Guren. He was an expert on "forbidden" Hive arcana; for that reason, he was recruited by the Praxic Warlock Eriana-3 to be part of the six Guardian Fireteam who delved into the Hellmouth in search of Crota. Considering only Eris came back alive, he was assumed to be dead. But unlike the other members of the fireteam, his fate was never witnessed by anyone else. After Eris' return to the City and the start of her cooperation with the Guardian, messages purportedly written by Toland were discovered, indicating he yet survived in the Ascendant Realm. He attempted to communicate to the Guardian by unknown means, as he was taking "a debased joy in speaking again to small human-form heads." He is believed to be the creator of Bad Juju, an exotic pulse rifle covered in the bones of an unknown creature. In addition, Toland is said to have left behind Shadow Price, a legendary auto rifle issued to the Vanguard. Along with Eris and the Guardian, he has also forged Deathbringer, an exotic rocket launcher that repurposes a captured Deathsong.

Thox, the Smoldering Wasp was a Cabal Incendior that was encountered in the European Dead Zone Flashpoint. However, Thox's appearance was removed along with the all other Flashpoints and their bosses with the release of Beyond Light.

Ticuu was a Psion craftsman. He was a great craftsman capable of powerful psionics. He used his powers as part of an excruciating ritual called "dry joining", that allowed him to bind time into a bow. As the last part of the ritual, he pulled the bowstring, piercing his own eye with three arrows, as if they had always been there, dying but successfully crafting the Exotic Bow Ticuu's Divination. The weapon would end up in Emperor Calus's armory, then looted by Cabal Legionaries, and eventually found its way into the hands of The Guardian.

The KORD is a Russian-made Heavy Machine Gun that was developed in 1998 to replace the NSV machine gun. While it resembles the NSV, the internal mechanism has been extensively reworked, changing from a horizontally pivoting breech block to a rotating bolt design. Additionally the gas system has been changed and the muzzle baffle redesigned. These changes give the weapon reduced recoil compared with the NSV, allowing greater accuracy during sustained fire.

Tiānshǐ was a Ghost who attempted to lead a small band of survivors to the Last City, since they couldn't find their Guardian. The group was cautious of them, but came to see them as an angel and named them Tiānshǐ. After they were attacked by the Fallen, Tiānshǐ noticed a spark in a child that had died. They resurrected him, and Tiānshǐ questioned if they made the right choice, but realized they did after seeing the joy on the group's faces. Months later the group was attacked again, and the child's parents were killed almost immediately. Tiānshǐ left the child in the care of two members of their group and left in an attempt to draw the Fallen away, but was killed in the process.

Urrox, Flame Prince, also known as the "scion of Oryx", is a Hive Knight found in the Prison of Elders in Destiny. Urrox held watch over an ancient brood that has long since vanished. He has a special ability where if he stomps the ground, the floor will cause Solar damage to Guardians for ten seconds. He is killed in the mission Prison of Elders: Urrox's Grudge. Years after his death, the forces of the Lucent Brood would invade the now Tomb of Elders in search for the Echo in the hands of Fikrul, the Fanatic. Urrox would be one of the Hive to be risen by a Hive Ghost, reborn as Urrox, the Risen Ember.

Tulkor, Ferocity of Xivu Arath is a large Hive Ogre encountered in the Broken Courier Mission. They were deployed in the Dreaming City to defend stolen Awoken Artifacts after a successful raid on an Awoken temple, but were killed by The Guardian.

The , or Landing Craft, Vehicle, Personnel, was an American assault boat that saw widespread use in both European and Pacific theaters. It was famous for its ability to transport an entire platoon of troops from ship to shore, and extricate itself without being beached. The LCVP appears in Battlefield 1942, Battlefield Vietnam, Battlefield 1943 and Battlefield V. A stylized LCVP also appears in Battlefield Heroes.
Uolot is a Psion that was surgically flayed by the Witness into creating reshaped duplicates of herself as Attendants to serve as part of the Dread.
Uplifted Choral Hydras are a variant of Hydra within the Nessian Schism.

Vex Minds (or Axis Minds) are powerful Vex units with the ability to control masses of other Vex units. They are to carry out a specific goal, as they are distributions of the Vex collective mind. Vex Minds most commonly take on the form of Minotaurs or Hydras, though there are also Hobgoblins, Harpies, Cyclopses and Wyverns that hold this position.

The M72 LAW (English: Light Anti-armor Weapon) is a rocket launcher featured in Battlefield Vietnam. It is a 66mm rocket launcher, formerly used by U.S. and their ally forces during the Vietnam War in order to fill the role of a light, man-portable anti-armor weapon (hence the designation) to replace the bulkier M20A1 Bazooka and the more obsolete M31 rifle grenade. It was later replaced by the Swedish M136 AT4 in 1987. It has re-entered service with the USMC due to the AT4 having problems in urban scenarios.
Val Hragan, Lighteater was a Taken Centurion encountered in the Visions of Light Quest, where Hragan was seen fighting Outopos, Stranded in the Grove of Ulan-Tan.

Vakarsik, Grasp of Quria is a giant Taken Captain found in the Heroic version of the Public Event The Rift Generator, where they are found to be regenerating thanks to several Taken Wizards conducting a ritual.

Val Ma'rag was a Cabal Incendior with the rank of Val, and one of the few surviving Red Legion officers still left in the Sol System when Empress Caiatl arrived to reclaim the Legion. Seeking to gain her favor, Ma'rag struck at the Hive nests of the Cosmodrome but was killed in battle against the Guardians.

The Light Armored Vehicle-25 (LAV-25) is an eight-wheeled amphibious infantry fighting vehicle built by General Dynamics Land Systems Canada, based on the MOWAG Piranha and is used by the United States Navy SEALs and the United States Marine Corps in the Battlefield series. __TOC__
Valir was a Psion of the Imperial Cabal and a member of Yirix's conspiracy to assassinate Commander Zavala to complete Amtec's mission of revenge for the deaths of Niruul, Ozletc, and Tazaroc.

Viraak, Cruelty of Xivu Arath is a powerful Hive Wizard encountered in the Broken Courier Mission. They were tasked with defending the gateway into the Gardens of Esila in order to protect the various stolen relics from the Awoken, before they were killed by The Guardian.
Uss Uik, Bound is a Lightbearer Wizard striving to challenge the Guardian's claim to the Taken Throne. They serve as one of the bosses of the Court of Blades activity.

The is an American-made light machine gun designed in 1940 by Melvin Johnson. It was developed from the rifle of the same name. It uses an in-line stock to decrease the weapons recoil, especially with the weapon's recoil operation. It used a 20-round magazine with .30-06 Springfield rounds. Though it was not mass-produced, the few that were issued to special divisions of the US Army Rangers. One notable unit that used the Johnson machine gun was the U.S. Army's First Special Service Force, a special operations unit composed of half Canadian, half American troops known as "Devil's Brigade".

Warrior's Enforcers are Stasis-wielding Captains that belong to the House of Salvation. They are tasked by Phylaks, the Warrior, to protect her or her soldiers. They can be seen scouting around the Rathmore Chaos, hoping to find something for their commander. These chosen soldiers have a medium amount of cream-colored armor over their baggy white undersuits, maintaining the full fluffy collar of a standard captain but without their iconic cape. Thick blue hoses run down their upper left arm, responsible for their use of Stasis.
The Wyvern Exemplar is an unique Wyvern that acts as the final encounter boss for the "Aspect of Influence" and "Aspect of Interference" Stasis Quests.

Wrathborn Captains are Fallen Captains whose minds have been altered by Hive Cryptoliths, turning into Wrathborn to serve Xivu Arath, God of War. Their corruption renders them completely mindless and enraged, causing them to behave more erratically than regular Captains, moving faster and fighting more aggressively. They are distinguished by the green aura around their head.
The Chengdu J-10 is a multirole fighter aircraft designed and produced by the People's Republic of China, is operated by the People's Liberation Army, and appears in Battlefield 2. __TOC__

Wrathborn Vandals are Fallen Vandals whose minds have been altered by Hive Cryptoliths, turning into Wrathborn to serve Xivu Arath, God of War. Their corruption renders them completely mindless and enraged, causing them to behave more erratically than regular Vandals, moving faster and fighting more aggressively. They are distinguished by the green aura around their head.

Wrathborn Servitor are Fallen Servitors that have had their programming altered by Hive Cryptoliths, turning into Wrathborn to serve Xivu Arath, God of War. Their corruption renders them completely berserk, causing them to behave more erratically than regular Servitors, moving faster and fighting more aggressively. They are distinguished by the green aura around their chassis.
Xûr's Chosen, Special Guest Star is an invisible Taken Minotaur in the Dares of Eternity.
The M113 is an American armored personnel carrier developed by BAE Systems and put into service in 1960. __TOC__

Zakharik Gilmanovich Bekhterev was a member of the Future War Cult during the Golden Age who participated in experiments with a device based on Vex technology that allowed its user to send their mind across space and time.

Yor ur-Halaku, Lightsinger is a former member of the Blood of Oryx, and current member of the Lucent Brood. She is killed by the Guardian and her limb severed under the Drifter's orders to gather biological codes to hack into the Dreadnaught.
Zuu Sel, Elusive Shadow is a Taken Minotaur striving to challenge the Guardian's claim to the Taken Throne. They serve as one of the bosses of the Court of Blades activity.

The L5 Riesig (German for 'gigantic') is a heavily armoured, powerful and maneuverable German Battle Walker used by the European Union during the 22nd Century. It appears in Battlefield 2142. The Riesig was inspired by the PAC's 'T1' Battle Walker, which would eventually be developed into the T-39 Bogatyr. Whilst PAC has long had the more advanced Battle Walkers, the latest versions of the Riesig are up to the standard of their counterparts by the outbreak of The Cold War. At long range, the Riesig's AV missiles snake around less than the Bogatyr, giving it a slight advantage.

Black Souls are variants of the Willowisp. They are the largest Willowisp variant, standing at eight feet tall. They are the spirits of evil beings who died searching the swamps of Kurast for dark, lost secrets of power.

Bone Fetish are undead versions of normal Fetish and can be encountered in various dungeons and temples of Act III of Diablo II. Though their bodies are fragile they move at an incredible speed and deal high amounts of damage: it's best to kill them as fast as possible. However, they have one additional feature that makes them even more lethal: upon death they explode, dealing even more damage. This makes Bone Fetishes one of the most dangerous monsters in the game, especially when found in a group. The exploding damage is based upon the amount of life they were spawned with. When playing with a full party, be warned, as the damage potential can be severe. Freezing them with cold attacks and finishing them off from a distance is one way to deal with this. Hirelings are immune to the Bone Fetish death explosion, so Act II and Act V Hirelings who use melee attacks can help keep them at a distance, as can summons like Golems who are also immune. Aside from having something to tank them or the usual methods of crowd control, the Sanctuary aura can be highly effective at keeping Bone Fetishes at arm's length. Be especially wary of sources of damage that can easily kill Bone Fetishes at the wrong time, such as Hurricane, Armageddon, Fist of the Heavens, Strafe, Traps, or poison damage. Blinks are a variation of the Winged Fiend . Though they lack resistances and immunities, they can be potentially lethal in large swarms. In addition, Blinks have the ability to teleport. While they teleport, they regenerate health at a vastly increased rate.

The M-46, formally 130mm towed field gun M1954, is a 130mm artillery piece manufactured by the Soviet Union during the mid-20th century. The length of the field gun is 11.73 meters and has an effective firing range of 23 miles. Russia, formerly the Soviet Union, has discontinued the production of the field gun, but the People's Republic of China continues to produce its own variant, the Type 59-1.
Bog Creatures are an Frog Demon type. They can spawn in Great Marsh alongside the weaker Swamp Dwellers. They spit fire balls contradicting lore, but don't have any fire resistance.
Burning Souls are variants of the Willowisp. These beings hate the living, and attack viciously until killed. They can also form from the ghosts of people who died in fire.

Born was a famous warrior, known for rushing headlong into battle against superior numbers with no thought for his own safety. Often, he carried the day on nothing more than his unrelenting fury. Until recent times, none had been able to mimic the subtle intricacies of the armor he wore, as the key to it was said to be lost among the often-robbed graves of the dead.

The M110 is a self-propelled gun featured in Battlefield Vietnam. The M110 was used extensively by the United States Army during the Vietnam War. It saw very limited action, only in the Vietnam conflict and several Israeli battles. Though the United States no longer use this weapon, the M110 is still in use by several different countries including Turkey. It was an effective weapon against North Vietnamese Army and Viet Cong compounds.
Broodlords are vampire-esque monsters found in the Fractured Peaks in Diablo IV. They have a teleport-like ability, disappearing and reappearing in puffs of smoke.
Sister Chakin is a member of the Alliance of the Dying Sun. She placed a portal in the Desolate Sands.
Corvian Hunters are aerial avian predators encountered in the Shrouded Moors of in Diablo III.

The Lynx scout car was a Canadian reconnaissance 4WD vehicle designed by Ford Canada. It entered service with Commonwealth forces in 1943. The Lynx was closely related to the British Daimler Dingo, which used a similar hull, though with a different chassis.

Corphet the Venomwing was a creature found inside the Chamber of Wisdom, entrusted with guarding one of the three pieces of the Scepter of Fahir. Many adventurers died over the ages trying to obtain the pieces, possibly some at Corphet's hand. Corphet possessed venom that could twist skin in an instant. Corphet was slain in 1270, and his slayer(s) took the piece for themselves.

Corvik was a nephalem. Silent, and originally pale-skinned, she was an accomplished huntress, her knives easily able to take down her prey, and had the greatest skill in stalking unseen when compared to her peers. Due to her madness, her skin turned a mottled red.The Gospel of Death

was a Druid chieftain who rode into battle in armor made of moonstone, believing it contained the spirits of her ancestors. It protected her through many victories until she died of old age—called home, some say, to join the spirits in the stone.

The Kettenkrad (English: Tracked Motorcycle) is a light tractor for German airborne troops designed to be delivered directly by aircraft, not by parachute. By the time production ceased in 1944, almost 8,345 were made and over 500 more were built postwar for agricultural use.

Desert Crawlers (also called Desert Scorpions) are a type of scorpid creature found in the Shassar Sea. Their stingers are laced with a deadly poison that can kill within minutes after impalement. They bury beneath the sands, lying in wait to strike at unsuspecting travelers. Their chitin is toxic to the touch, and is tough enough to use to make armor. The Crawlers are apparently aggressive—so much so that their presence stymied Westmarch's plans to open trade with the region. Later, Westmarch offered bounties to those who could clear the region of these creatures. Their venom can be used to make a concoction that can cure hallucinations. It has been described to be like "a swift punch the brain", by those unlucky to sniff it. It can also be used to make ink.

Drakon was an Elder Crusader. He believed in precision, and trained his apprentice to strike fewer targets, but with more power. At some point he traveled with fellow Crusaders Haull, Inhora, and Roland, sharing knowledge and wine along the way.

Brother Draves is a member of the Alliance of the Dying Sun. He placed a portal in the Dahlgur Oasis. He reacted with surprise after hearing of how Elder Brother Lyam had managed to place a portal inside the Pinnacle of Heaven.

The Khaybar KH2002 is an Iranian-indigenously produced 5.56x45mm bullpup rifle, built upon a bullpup conversion of the DIO S-5.56 assault rifle, an Iranian version of the Chinese Norinco CQ rifle, which itself is a clone of the M16A1 with a different stock and handguard. It is intended to replace the aging G3 in the Iranian Army. It has an effective range in excess of 450 meters and a firerate of 800 - 850 RPM.

Duskbringer is the master of the Dusk Priests. By 1270 his followers tried to resurrect him, but the ritual was interrupted by an adventurer. Fortunately, it had progressed enough for Duskbringer to return as a phantom. Duskbringer was then defeated by the adventurer.

Drowned Seahags are a type of Drowned boss enemy in Diablo IV. The Drowned Seahag is a large humanoid boss with power over water. The Drowned Seahag fights with a club and summons Drowned Wretches from the depths. The Drowned Seahag will unleash geysers of water from the ground and her loud shout will send the Drowned Wretches around her into a frenzy.
Ezter was a Veradani Monk. He was presumably gifted with the Fists of Thunder.

The Landing Amphibious Vehicle-Air Defense (LAV-AD) is an air defense variant of the LAV-25 operated by the United States Marine Corps. It is fitted with an electric turret mounting a General Dynamics GAU-12/U Equalizer Gatling cannon, and two missile pods each with four FIM-92 Stinger missiles for short range air defense duties over its normal M242 Bushmaster cannon. It has a capacity of 990 rounds of 25mm ammunition and 16 missiles. It has since been removed from service due to high maintenance costs. __TOC__

Fangstorms (a.k.a. the Blood Magus) are a type of monster encountered in Diablo IV in the Fractured Peaks. They attack from range and have a teleport-esque ability, where they transform into a swarm of bats and appear at a different location.

Fauztin, a character in Richard A. Knaak's Diablo novel Legacy of Blood. Fauztin is one of Sadun Tryst and Norrec Vizharan's greatest friends and ally. He travelled with them for many years in search of treasure. Fauztin is one of the Vizjerei. Until he met a horrific end at the hands of an unwilling host.

Finger Mages were created during the Mage Wars. Sorcerers used these creatures to defeat rival sorcerers, reasoning that an enemy spellcaster weakened by taking away all of his mana. When the Mage Wars were over, Finger Mages were abandoned and left to die. Many of these creatures are found in Hell because they seek great sources of energy there. These undead monstrosities have the ability to fire homing "missiles" that drain the mana of its target. In addition, they possess the ability to stun whatever they attack. Mostly they appear in Act IV in the City of the Damned, the River of Flame and the Chaos Sanctuary. Finger Mages have three variants: * Doom Caster * Strangler * Storm Caster On Hell difficulty, all variants of the Finger Mage are immune to . Also all variants have a resistance to Fire on Normal and Nightmare, but lose it in Hell. The Grand Vizier of Chaos is a super unique Finger Mage and also one of Diablo's three elite guards.

The Landing Craft Air Cushion (LCAC) is a class of air-cushion vehicle (hovercraft) used as landing craft by the United States Navy and the Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force (JMSDF). They transport weapons systems, equipment, cargo and personnel of the assault elements of the Marine Air/Ground Task Force both from ship to shore and across the beach. __TOC__

Flesh Shamans are a variant of Flesh Golem. They are tougher than Flesh Gorgers, but move slower. They attack by hurling bolts of Fire, which deal significant damage from afar. It is advised to kill them first, lest they will resurrect killed Gorgers (note that they can only resurrect Gorgers). On Torment difficulty, the presence of Shamans prevents players from destroying the Gorgers' bodies by all means except Critical Hits.

Geleona was a dark-skinned enchantress who helped General Augustus Malevolyn. She was considered attractive, with lush black hair, an enticing figure, and red lips. She was proficient in magic, able to cast it, and sense the magic of demons.
Lord Greenstone was a figure who, according to legend, would cool himself down on hot days with the wind of hurled knives.

The Logistics Vehicle System (LVS) is a modular assortment of eight-wheel drive all-terrain vehicles used by the United States Marine Corps. Its main purpose is to haul supplies from military bases to front line troops.
Hale is a former Paladin of Zakarum. He possesses both great conviction, as well as great physical strength, able to wield a sword with ease and dispatch multiple foes in combat.

Imris was an ancient sage capable of wielding magic. He traveled the world, seeking a way to retune the Worldstone to restore the power of the nephalem. He fabricated a belt to help maintain his powers when fighting enemies.
Idalki is a healer who lives in Bramwell. She treated Jacob Staalek's wounds after a battle with a Sicarai.

The Landing Vehicle Tracked (LVT) was a class of amphibious warfare vehicle, a small amphibious landing craft, introduced by the United States Navy, Marine Corps, and Army during World War II. Originally intended solely as cargo carriers for ship to shore operations, they rapidly evolved into assault troop and fire support vehicles as well. The types were all widely known as "amphtrack", "amtrak", "amtrac", etc. (a portmanteau of amphibious tractor).
Ili is a member of the Monks of Ivgorod. She was at least the rank of Master. She is notable for inventing the Crushing Palm.
Kamyr, Stalker of the Shadows was a Sorcerer and member of the Imperial Guard in service to Belial. He was slain by The Nephalem as he attempted to defend his master.
According to Dreadlands legend, Kunai was an uncanny Demon Hunter who could become one with shadow.

The , of the program, is a developmental light machine gun. The LSAT LMG provides a major reduction in weight over older weapons such as the M249 SAW, as well as improvements in other areas, such as controllability and reliability.

Korelan was the son of Korsikk and the third king of Westmarch. Korelan died without an heir, leaving the future of Westmarch in question. Ultimately, he was succeeded by Justinian I, ending the first dynasty and starting its second. In truth, however, Korelan fathered at least one child, with Wynton claiming the right to the throne through Korelan's bloodline. Korelan was buried in a tomb, with flowers, gold, and his sword and shield. He was resurrected by an unknown individual, who announced that Korelan could now call them "master."

Kutzin the Scholar, Purveyor of Forbidden Research was a member of the Horadrim; one of those who was sent into the Library of Zoltun Kulle to confront Zoltun Kulle himself. However, like the rest of the expedition, Ardeg was struck down and resurrected as an undead slave. Centuries later, he could still be found inside the library.

Khleric was once the chieftain of the Owl Tribe. He became infected with the Rage Plague and spread it amongst his tribesmen and beyond. Eventually, he became the avatar of Maluus (the demon behind the plague), and by the time he was killed, his body had been warped to horrific proportions.

The L 2 H 143, also known as the Kfz. 70 and unofficially designated the Kruppe Protze, is a six-wheeled 6x4 German truck and artillery tractor produced between 1934 and 1941 that saw heavy use by the Wehrmacht during World War II. It was primarily used to tow the Pak 36 anti-tank gun, but could also be used to carry supplies and transport troops. Certain vehicles served as gun platforms, mounting artillery directly onto the flat bed of the vehicle. About 7,000 were produced in total.
Lempo was a demon. He was among the most beautiful of demons before he lost his wings.

Lieutenant Clyfton was a soldier of Westmarch, stationed at Bastion's Keep when it was besieged by Azmodan. He stayed at his post, even as all his men died around him. When The Nephalem arrived, Clyfton, much to his chagrin, single-handedly raised a catapult, while The Nephalem fended off attacking demons. With that done, he asked The Nephalem if they could not tell Captain Haile that he'd shouted at them, as he'd promised him that he'd watch his temper.

Lidar the Noble was a nephalem and companion of Daedessa. According to legend, he infused Corvus with a form of magic that could ward off trespassing angels and demons. He supposedly played a role in the construction of the mystic seals around Sanctuary that protect it from the prying eyes of angels and demons. Some believe that Lidar knew the whereabouts of Daedessa after she disappeared. If so, he took it to his grave.

The Chengdu J-20 (Jian-20) (Chinese: 歼-二十) is a fifth generation, stealth, twin engine, single-seat fighter aircraft being developed by the Chengdu Industry Group for the Chinese People's Liberation Army Air Force (PLAAF). It entered active service in March 2017. __TOC__

The is an undead construct created by an unbalanced Fire of Life by fusing the corpses of dead Terror Cultists. It was made to prevent people from further unbalancing it by tampering with one of its conduit obelisks.

Malah was a healer. A kind and inherently optimistic woman, Malah was nevertheless worn down by many battles against the forces of evil. Her compassion as a healer extended to all of humankind, if not the forces of Hell.

The Malformed Crusher is an Aberration encountered in the Library of Zoltun Kulle in Diablo Immortal. The Crushers attack at melee with claw swipes with their smaller arms, and at range with Bone Spikes created from their malformed arms. They can also ambush the player by dropping from above,.

The JGBG M7 riflescope is a Chinese, 4x30 compact and waterproof rifle scope with red laser sight and illuminated red/green rangefinder reticle. It is featured in Battlefield 4 as a weapon optic called the JGM-4.
s are a variant of the Maddened featured in Diablo Immortal. They can be found in the World's Crown zone, and attack using swipes with their hand claws and by shooting s of blood.
Khazra of the Night Clan have the ability to blend into darkness. During the Darkening of Tristram, Night Clan khazra were seen beneath the Tristram Cathedral.

Elder Brother Morbihan is a member of the Alliance of the Dying Sun. Morbihan came to the Flooded Causeway in Caldeum in order to place a portal. Some merchants who were using the causeway to peddle their wares came upon his work. He killed them with minimal effort, and completed his task.

The CS/LS2 (also known as the JS9) is a Chinese select-fire bullpup submachine gun designed in 2005 by Jianshe Industry Group and built by China South Industries Group. It is the export version of the locally built QCW-05 chambered in the more common 9x19mm Parabellum pistol cartridge rather than the Chinese 5.8x21mm DCV05 round. It is also capable of using standard MP5 magazines.
Sister Morfan is a member of the Alliance of the Dying Sun. She placed a portal in the Ancient Waterway, though her boots and pants got soaked in the process.
Night Howlers (a.k.a. Werewolves) are large, bipedal wolf-like predators.
Swamp Dwellers are an Frog Demon type. They can spawn in Great Marsh alongside the stronger Bog Creatures. They spit fire balls against their lore.
.]] A Laser/Light Combo is a weapon attachment which allows the user to switch between a laser aiming dot or a flashlight, depending on the situation. __TOC__

The Banished are Vampires of a greenish color, existing in the deeper areas of the Catacombs of the Rogue Monastery, always in Level 3 along with Ghouls. They attack with a type of that they shoot from a distance. Unlike the stronger Vampire variants, who can bring down s and erect walls of fire, these have no special skills of their own beyond the typical vampiric Leech-life Ball. When in sight of a fleeing adventurer, they will rarely give up pursuit, being able to keep a steady and quick speed to stay in sight of their prey as they are the fastest variant of Vampires, unless low on health. They are found commonly in Unique/Champion groups. They have a 55% chance of Cold on melee. They start retreating when at 20/40/50% health. They are usually found on their own.

The Tempest Stone Thief was a thief who stole the Tempest Stone from Trond. Utilizing the stone's power, he was able to manipulate the wind to his advantage, hindering the adventurer chasing him. However, he ran afoul of an Enormous Rockworm, which devoured him.

T'jier was a healer. Upon discovering a sacred oasis and donning the ancient mask found within, T'jier became one with the oasis. Thus began his days of helping those lost among the sands. In exchange for knowledge of their deepest secret, T'jier would happily heal their ailments and send them on towards their destination.

] A Laser Guided missile tracks a target marked with laser designation either from the launch platform itself or external sources such as other aircraft, troops or ground vehicles via optical hardware built into the nose of the missile.

The Ash Knight is a Rogue dedicated to hunting demons. As the minions of Hell hide in the dark places of Sanctuary, so too does the Ash Knight lurk in these same shadows, dispatching any demon that dares set foot on Sanctuary. It is believed the Ash Knight imbibes embers from vanquished prey, making them more resistant to the powers of demons.

"The Brawler" was a seasoned fighter who operated during the Great Enmity. Travelling light, the Brawler kept just enough to live off until the next fight. Belligerent and streetwise, the Brawler couldn't help but get into brawls wherever he went. During his travels, the Brawler fought in the Pit. Many looked down at his bedraggled dress and underestimated him.
The Thousand-Eyed King was a monarch of old. No falsehood could endure his reaver nor its countless eyes.

The LD-2000 Anti-Air emplacement is a land-based variant of the Type 730 (H/PJ12) a Chinese seven-barreled 30mm Gatling gun CIWS. In place of the Type 730's electro-optical tracking system, it has a thermal imaging sight to supplement the radar system. Its maximum rate of fire is 5800 RPM, and the effective range is up to three kilometers.
Uliana was a of Ivgorod who departed the order to wander Sanctuary. The ferocity of her unrelenting attacks was often compared to that of a lion.

Tsagal was a horse that originated from the peaks of the Northern Steppes. He appeared after the Battle of Nine Winters, which had trapped clans in its wake. The storm parted when Tsagal appeared, and was named as such; the chief of all horses.
Vhalit was a Monk of Ivgorod. He was driven mad by the corruption within the Madstone.
A Kilo-class Submarine is the NATO reporting name for a naval diesel-electric submarine that is made in Russia. It is in use with countries such as Russia, China and India.
Utar was apparently a . According to the Chronicles of the North, Utar's blade hewn from the never-melting ice of the summit of Mount Paolarr, and retained its chill.

The Lamborghini Huracán (English: Hurricane) is a luxury Italian sports car first produced in 2014. Named after a Spanish fighting bull like several other Lamborghini cars, the Huracán replaced the Lamborghini Gallardo, which was the company's best selling vehicle and former entry model. The Huracán has a top speed of greater than 325 km/h (202 mph), and can reach 97 km/h in 3.2 seconds. The is a British light machine gun of American design, that was used heavily by the Allies, particularly Great Britain, in World War I and, to a lesser extent, in World War II. The design of the Lewis would go on to be an inspiration for the German FG42, which in turn inspired the M60 machine gun still in use today.

The Motoscafo Armato Silurante (Torpedo Armed Motorboat) is an Italian fast attack craft used during World War I and World War II to combat enemy submarines. MAS 15, a 30-ton boat that entered service in 1916, was credited with the sinking of the SMS Szent István, an Austro-Hungarian battleship. It is preserved at a museum on the grounds of Il Vittoriano in Rome, Italy.

As the winner of 1934 Poland's self-loading rifle trials, it received orders for further development and testing. The further development and production of the weapon ceased due to the of 1939, at which point only around 150 units had been produced. The rifle had only one documented combat use.

The Saab JAS 39 Gripen is a light single-engine supersonic multirole fighter aircraft manufactured by the Swedish aerospace and defence company Saab AB. The Gripen has a delta wing and canard configuration with relaxed stability design and fly-by-wire flight controls. Later aircraft are fully NATO interoperable. The Gripen has designations depending on the nation that has adopted it, such as F-39E for its adoption in Brazil. __TOC__

The surface of its skin has been modified with a special texture, and is capable of displaying a variety of camouflage patterns. Likes: taking walks. Dislikes: fighting.

Wada Koji (和田 光司, Wada Kouji; January 29, 1974 – April 3, 2016) was a Japanese singer. He made his debut in 1999, performing his first single, Butter-Fly, the opening theme of Digimon Adventure and later provided other opening and ending themes, in addition to insert songs, to subsequent Digimon anime series up until his death. His nickname was the "Immortal Butterfly Singer" (不死蝶のアニソンシンガー, Fushichou no Anison Shingā).
A Possessed Engineer is a former welder turned demon that has an explosive blow torch. They appear in DOOM. They first appear in Resource Operations.
==Battlefield 6== The LMR27, or the ARADMR in development, is a designated marksman rifle featured in Battlefield 6. It is unlocked at rank 16.

The Adventures of MassMouth is the first in a series of three PWADs by Mike "Cyb" Watson. The original version was released on February 23, 2000. This does not run with the latest versions of ZDoom, so the older version 1.22 is needed to play it. In 2003, an updated version was released titled The Adventures of MassMouth Do Over!, fixing bugs and also adding several extra features. This updated version runs properly with version 2.0 of ZDoom. MassMouth is an alien from the planet Zeeble (a zeebloid). He has a small, green body with a large mouth. An antenna containing a single eye protrudes from his body. He also has two arms and legs. MassMouth resembles the Yorps of the Commander Keen series. MassMouth's preferred weapon is his ray-gun, a weapon which shoots green bolts. The design of MassMouth comes from a Quake II player model created by Stephen "Neuralstasis" Monteith. Massmouth is an employee of The Worm, a rich alien with his own personal moon. The Worm employs MassMouth to bring him various valuable items. MassMouth is very well-paid and has his own personal room.

For the adaption equivalent, see Tariq/2000 miniseries Assan Tariq [d. 10219 AG] was the child guide of The Preacher. He tried to kill the Preacher and Leto Atreides II by means of activating a Pseudo-shield in the desert, attracting a Sandworm. Leto, using his newfound strength from the Sandtrout, snapped Tariq's neck and flung the shield away.

Chirox was such a combat mek. Chirox, like all combat meks, had several arms which could change shape and inflict damage to humans.

The [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Joint_Light_Tactical_Vehicle Joint Light Tactical Vehicle] (JLTV), known and marketed under Oshkosh development as the L-ATV (Light Combat Tactical All-Terrain Vehicle), is a light utility/combat multi-role vehicle. The Oshkosh-developed JLTV was selected for acquisition under the US military's Army-led Joint Light Tactical Vehicle program. __TOC__

Ginaz Tenth Level was the highest level of proficiency of Ginaz Swordmasters. Tenth Level Swordmasters were considered to be superior warriors during the time of the Faufreluches. They were even considered to be superior to Sardaukar soldiers.

Nuwa Cenva was the brilliant automaton engineer of House Vernius during the Spice War. Many of Vernius' breakthroughs at the time were attributed to Nuwa's skills. During the latter stages of the war, she was brought to Arrakis assist the war effort and ensure that all went according to plan. She developed a Repair station which could repair Vernius Drones at long ranges and make their weaponry more powerful.

Radnor was a Mentat of House Harkonnen. He assassinated the previous Mentat Marko, his former teacher, and took his position. Radnor was in charge of that House's operations on Arrakis. Radnor had a lust for power and was extremely persuasive.

The (English: Carbine 1898 Short), commonly abbreviated to Kar98k, K98k or K98, is a bolt-action rifle created and designed in 1934 by . Its predecessor, the Gewehr 98, was designed in 1898, hence its name. The Kurz model was developed to be more versatile as it has a shorter barrel. In 1935, it was adopted by the Wehrmacht as their standard-issue rifle until their defeat in 1945.

Proctor Superior was a title for Bene Gesserit Reverend Mothers who were regional directors of Bene Gesserit schools. Reverend Mother Gaius Helen Mohiam was Proctor Superior of the Wallach IX Bene Gesserit School.

[d. 88 BG] was a thinking machine captain to the Omnius update ship Dream Voyager. He was friends with Vorian Atreides, who frequently flew with him on his Omnius update journeys. He had a resilient, fibrous body.

Captain Alistair d'Lyrandar is the captain of the luxury galleon Golden Dragon. While he is a high-ranking member of House Lyrandar, as his position as captain of such a high-profile vessel warrants, his prior career was somewhat rocky with several vessels suffering accidents under his command, so his management of this key commission will likely determine his ultimate status in the house. He bears a lesser Mark of Storm. His first mate on the Golden Dragon is Lieutenant Mazzia d'Lyrandar.

The Ju-87 Sturzkampfflugzeug, abbreviated Stuka (English: Dive Bomber), was a German two-seat dive bomber used in World War II, aircraft was easily recognizable by its inverted gull wings, fixed Aircraft fairing undercarriage and its infamous Jericho-Trompete ("Jericho Trumpet") wailing siren, becoming the propaganda symbol of German air power and the blitzkrieg victories of 1939–1942.

The bloodstriker is a four-legged dinosaur with a thick, spiked hide. Two large horns jut from the bloodstriker's forehead, which it uses to burrow away from hunters. Bloodstrikers weigh about and measure long.

A bugbear is a massive humanoid distantly related to, but larger and stronger than, goblins and hobgoblins. Like many goblinoids, bugbears speak Goblin. They are one of the only goblinoids to be covered in fur. Like the other goblinoids in Eberron, bugbears were once part of the dominant civilization of Khorvaire thousands of years ago. Today, they are found across Eberron, but are most likely to be found as part of the Ghaal'dar, Marguul, or the Dhakaani.
Carash is a male medusa of Cazhaak Draal in Droaam. Representing Sheshka, the Queen of Stone, he serves as the ambassador to the Daughters of Sora Kell at the court of the Great Crag.

The laser has in most firearms applications been used as a tool to enhance the targeting of other weapon systems. For example, a laser sight is a small, usually visible-light laser placed on a handgun or a rifle and aligned to emit a beam parallel to the barrel. Since a laser beam has low divergence, the laser light appears as a small spot even at long distances; the user places the spot on the desired target and the barrel of the gun is aligned (but not necessarily compensating for bullet drop or the target moving while the bullet travels). The Laser Sight appears as a weapon attachment in Battlefield 3, Battlefield 4, and Battlefield Hardline, modeled after the AN/PEQ-2. __TOC__

Alask d'Jorasco is a halfling member of House Jorasco based in the Last Chance outpost in Xen'drik. He gives magical aid to those in need and maintains a small supply of potions. Though he might do better business in Stormreach, he chooses to be here to bring his house's aid to those who needed it. Many explorers are said to have come across Last Chance while in dire need or the edge of death. While Alask believes the Traveler's Curse brings them to his door, by the same token, the Curse also means some never get there.

Blackspawn stalkers are terrifying but nearly mindless predatory dragonspawn combining the worst traits of black dragons and spiders. A related creature is the blackspawn gloomweb, which can also shroud itself in darkness.

Alaran's gorgon is a huge golem based on a gorgon that resides within the ruins of Eston in the Mournland. Notably, it was a symbol of House Cannith. Originally, Alaran's gorgon served as the guardian of the vaults at the Cannith enclave in the Clockwork Garden. However, after the Mourning, it has become corrupted and breathes a corrupting gas.

The (Light Support Weapon) is a Light Support Weapon variant of the L85, featuring a longer barrel, aft-grip for supported shooting, and a bipod. Despite technically being an LMG, the L86's relatively small magazine size and lack of quick-change barrels cause it to be relatively unsuited to a suppressive fire role. However, its longer barrel provides superior accuracy and range, and as a result the L86 is generally employed as a Designated Marksman Rifle by British forces. The L86A1 variant was the initial version of the L86, but like the L85A1, it was plagued by reliability issues, and was upgraded to the significantly more dependable A2 standard in 2000. __TOC__
The couatl are celestial outsiders that appear as radiant, winged serpents.

Cockatrices are monstrous creatures that resemble a cross between a lizard and a bird. A cockatrice's bite is able to turn creatures into stone. Cockatrices are believed to be creations of the daelkyr Orlassk.

Dao are genies that have an affinity with the earth. They adorn themselves in precious gems and constantly seek out more rare gems and metals. They can be found in Lamannia. Dao can also be found in Fernia, where they harness the fires of the plane to forge items and artifacts of great value.

The (nicknamed Bora) is a bolt-action sniper rifle that uses the 7.62x51mm NATO cartridge designed and produced by Mechanical and Chemical Industry Corporation (MKEK). It is currently in use with the Azerbaijani and Turkish military. __TOC__

Flamewind is a gynosphinx with amazing oracular powers Found in Xen'drik in 996 YK, Flamewind resides at Morgrave University in Sharn, where she spends her time in the university's library in trade for her visions of things to come.
Duergar, sometimes called gray dwarves, are a race of psionic dwarves. They are known to dwell in various parts of Sarlona.
A duraak'ash (Orc for "stalking dragon") is a specialist hunter of House Tharashk who uses their Mark of Finding to stalk and hunt prey.
The , often shortened to simply the M95, is a bullpup, bolt-action, anti-materiel sniper rifle chambered for .50 BMG (12.7x99 mm), designed by Barrett Firearms Manufacturing in 1995.

The eneko are a race of ogre and half-giant hybrids in Sarlona. The eneko were born in Syrkarn after the Sundering, as ogre refugees joined with half-giant nomads. Deemed "mongrels", the eneko nevertheless thrived in their new environment, able to endure the elements while leaving no trace of their passing. To this day, most mongrel ogres reside in Syrkarn, though some have made their way to Adar and the Tashana Tundra. In Riedra, they are rarely allowed to exist, save as members of the Savage Legion.
Essence reavers are aberrations native to the continent of Sarlona. They are feared apex predators with a draconic aspect and murderous disposition that hunt sources of psionic or magical power.
Dragonspawn, also known as the spawn of Tiamat, are a type of creature descended from true dragons.

The is a main battle tank produced in the United States, which replaced the aging M60 Patton in 1980. It was designed by Chrysler Defense (now General Dynamics Land Systems). The M1 Abrams is named after General Creighton Abrams, former Army Chief of Staff and Commander of US military forces during the Vietnam War from 1968 to 1972. It is armed with a 120mm smoothbore cannon, two M240 machine guns, and a .50 Cal M2 Browning. __TOC__
Jode Jorasco is a halfling with the Mark of Healing and admitted ties to House Jorasco.
Jarlain is a psion who resides in Grimwall under the rule of Erdis Cai.
Hask Malevanor is an abactor (priest) of the Blood of Vol and the high priest of the Crimson Monastery in Atur, the largest Seeker monastery in Karrnath. He is a mummy and a powerful necromancer.

The M939 series 5-ton 6x6 truck is a family of United States military logistical transportation trucks which was designed in the late 1970s, based on the M809 series and eventually replaced it. It entered service in the early 1980s and has been used ever since.
Gorodan Ashlord is a fire giant who is one of the most powerful warlords of Droaam. Exiled from Xen'drik, Gorodan is now the leader of a clan of ogres and hill giants.
Haze-of-Death is a white dragon who was warped by the cataclysm that destroyed Cyre on the Day of Mourning. The dragon now lurks deep within the Mournland.
Glimmerdoom is a legendary monster of Xen'drik, a mutated behir with a mirror-like hide.

The Mark 14 Enhanced Battle Rifle (EBR) is an American selective fire military rifle based upon the M14 rifle. Originally created in 2001 for the United States Navy SEALs, it was first deployed for combat use in 2003. It is now used by the United States Army and Coast Guard. New improvements such an adjustable stock, Picatinny rails on the top and sides of the rifle and new construction techniques allow the M14 to become a highly adaptive rifle, yet it still retains its firepower coming from the powerful 7.62x51mm NATO round.

Called the Night Witch by friends and enemies alike, Major Ponická was a Flight Leader in the 401st Transport Squadron, an elite group of helicopter pilots that worked exclusively with Eurofed Special Forces units during the war. Her flight specializes in low-altitude, high-speed approaches to minimize air defense threats into and out of the drop zone. EC 222 Dragonfly.png|EC 222 Dragonfly

Thee Elder Bael is an enemy-only Monster class that is exclusive to The Sacred Stones. A breed of gargantuan spiders that are enlarged through the interference of fell magic, Elder Baels are the promoted form of the Bael class, employing their pincers and claws to inflict damage on their foes. More powerful and far deadlier than their unpromoted counterparts, Elder Baels are marked by a crimson colour scheme to highlight the danger that they present to players.

The Earth Dragon (地竜 Chiryū) is an enemy-only Dragon class that is introduced in Fire Emblem: Shadow Dragon and the Blade of Light. A class of Dragons aligned to the element of earth, the Earth Dragon either spews noxious fumes of toxic Breath or harnesses the power contained within Earthstones to launch attacks on its foes.

The M1903 Springfield is an American bolt-action service rifle designed around a modified Mauser action. The Springfield replaced the older Krag Jørgensen rifle used during the Spanish–American War. The rifle is similar in many respects to the German Gewehr 98, sharing such features as a claw extractor and a five-round internal box magazine, but differs notably in caliber and sight arrangement. The '03 was used extensively during World War I and the beginning of World War II (among US Marines) before being limited to use as a sniper's rifle as it was phased out by the M1 Garand.

Dáinn is a background character in Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War. He is one of the Twelve Crusaders, possesses the title of Dragon Knight, is the original wielder of the Gungnir, and is the founder of the Kingdom of Thracia. Dáinn's known blood descendants are Travant and Arion. His sister was Njörun, and is the indirect ancestor of Calf, Quan, Altena, and Leif. [http://www.serenesforest.net/general/designer4_2.html According to the designer notes], Dáinn and Njörun's lives took a turn for the tragic in what's known as the "Tragedy of the Gáe Bolg". Among the Thracian Knights there was an old friend of Dáinn; he and Njörun fell in love, and they got married with Dáinn's blessing. However, some time after the war, Dáinn and his brother-in-law fought for reasons undisclosed, and eventually started dueling each other. Njörun tried to stop the fight, but she accidentally killed her spouse with the Gáe Bolg. She was so grief stricken that she killed herself to join her husband in death, and few years later Dáinn also died under mysterious circumstances. Ever since then, Munster and Thracia have had bitterness between them.
Elm is a character from Fire Emblem Heroes who first appears in Book VI. He is a batlike being that serves as retainer to the goddess Embla, who tasked him with ending Askr's bloodline.

Eubans is an enemy character from Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade. He is the commander of a mercenary band which is extremely loyal to the Marquess Darin of Laus, as shown by his attack on Ostia being carried out, even after Darin abandoned them. He is known for his lightning-quick battle formation, which has made him known as the "Hurricane", although Legault has the same nickname, perhaps due to a translation oversight. In the Japanese version of the game, Eubans is known as the "Fierce Eagle", which fits well with the title of his introduction chapter, "Talons Alight".

The was an American general purpose machine gun designed in 1919 by , as an air-cooled development of the earlier M1917 Browning. It was a belt fed machine gun, usually used mounted on a bipod or tripod. During World War II, it fired , and had a rate of fire of around 500 rounds per minute, with an effective range of over a kilometer. It was used mostly by American forces, but also to many other Allied nations.
Feh is an owl in Fire Emblem Heroes and a messenger owl for the Order of Heroes.
Fiora is a playable character from Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade. She is the honorable commander of the 5th Wing of Ilia's Pegasus Knights. Fiora is also the older sister of Farina and Florina.

Frau is a playable character from TearRing Saga: Utna Heroes Saga. She is a fifteen-year-old Pegasus Knight in service to Salia. She is also the third daughter of Roberto and Clarice, making her younger than Verna and Mahter. Although both of her sisters consider her to be a child, she finds Mahter to be scary and does not regard Verna in the same way.
The M4 "Sherman" was an American-made, mass-produced medium tank. It proved effective during the Second World War, seeing extensive use in the Pacific and European theaters. __TOC__
Freyja is the main antagonist of Book IV from Fire Emblem Heroes. She is a Vanir, and the queen of Dökkálfheimr, the realm of nightmares.

Gareth is a non-playable character in Fire Emblem: Path of Radiance, and an enemy/playable character in Fire Emblem: Radiant Dawn. He is a member of the Red Dragon tribe of Goldoa, and body guard to King Dheginsea or any royal retainers in need of personal guard (as seen when he stayed near Prince Kurthnaga in their first appearance). Gareth is a loyal member of the Goldoan Royal Court. Although it is not clearly mentioned, he is a high-ranking member of the court and a retainer to both his King and Prince Kurthnaga.

The Gorgon is an enemy-only Monster class exclusive to Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones. Snake-like creatures with human heads and serpentine bodies, Gorgons are often armed with Stone, Demon Surge and Shadowshot, making them terrifying foes to behold. Hatched from Gorgon Eggs, Gorgons mainly inhabit Neleras Peak, with one appearing as a boss in Chapter 18.

The MG3 (German: Maschinengewehr 3; English: Machine Gun 3) is a German general purpose machine gun designed by Rheinmetall AG in 1959. The entire weapon system is an updated version of the famous MG42 universal machine gun that was used by the German Wehrmacht during World War II, sporting differences such as being chambered in 7.62x51mm NATO. Like its predecessor, it keeps its iconic rate of fire, ranging around 1200 rounds per minute.

Hanon, is a background character in the Elibe Series. Possessing the title of Horseman, she is one of the Eight Legends who fought against Dragons during the war known as The Scouring, and one of the two confirmed females in the group along with St. Elimine. She was the founder of Sacae, located in the northeastern part of Elibe. She wielded Mulagir, the Gale Bow, which is only obtainable in Fire Emblem: The Binding Blade. Due to her title and background, Hanon's class is most likely a variant of the Nomad Trooper class used by many of her descendants. Due to translation mistakes, Fire Emblem: The Blazing Blade refers to Hanon as a male.

Saint Indech is a character from Fire Emblem: Three Houses. He was one of the Four Saints who fought alongside Seiros during the War of Heroes. It is said that he was known for his wisdom and dexterity. Though unskilled in the art of human interaction, he used his skills to help those in need. He was also an indomitable warrior who slew many foes on many battlefields. Bernadetta and Hanneman possess the minor version of his Crest.
